# meok-libp2p-agent-mesh-mcp

> MEOK libp2p Agent Mesh MCP — peer-to-peer agent discovery + addressing. PeerID + multiaddr + signed Agent Records + GossipSub topic derivation. The mesh substrate under A2A / ACP / AP2 / x402. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- mint_peer_id
- generate_peer_keypair
- compose_multiaddr
- parse_multiaddr
- sign_agent_record
- verify_agent_record
- gossipsub_topic
- list_bootstrap_nodes
- normalise_protocol_id
- generate_agent_record_template

## Install
```
pip install meok-libp2p-agent-mesh-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-libp2p-agent-mesh-mcp/
